summary: Telefonica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing it acquired the 24.99% minority stake in Fibrasil Infraestrutura e Fibra Óptica S.A. (FiBrasil) held by Telefonica Infra S.L. Unipersonal for R$458.7 million (approx. US$86.8 million at current rates) paid in cash on signing. The transaction was preceded by an independent valuation and gives Telefonica Brasil 100% ownership and full consolidation of FiBrasil, part of its strategy to capture operational synergies in its fiber network. Deal contains customary provisions; no break fee or expected close date specified. Watch for future integration updates and potential fiber asset optimization moves; risk-arb angle minimal as deal closed on signing.
